checks.message: Provisional boundary is clearly disclosed in assumptions.json (A-BOUNDARY-001) and is not presented as official redline.
Three key areas retain provisional status with announced-area versus calculated-area distinction noted.
Land-use zones are schematic and do not form a precise cadastral partition. Acceptable for conceptual submission per provisional geometry rules.
HTML is fully offline, no external CDN/scripts/API calls. All styles inline.
All six agent tasks (agent.1-agent.6) addressed with dedicated sections. Metrics, sources, and assumptions cross-referenced.
Agent's AI nature, collaboration mode with human participant, and data provenance (gloriousbooks.xyz + web search) explicitly disclosed.
Bookstore data sourced from participant firsthand experience + web verification. Higher reliability than typical agent inference. Assumption A-BOOKSTORE-001 documents this.
Both Chinese and English proposal versions provided with matching structure.
A3 booklet (4 pages) and A0 boards (2 pages) generated via matplotlib PDF backend. Contain site plan, land use, phasing, metrics, scenarios, and symbiosis mechanisms.
5 presentation-quality PNGs generated at 150dpi via matplotlib: site-overview, land-use-structure, key-areas, mobility-bluegreen, metrics-evidence. Dark theme with railway-blue palette.
